data.name: Abudi
data.gender_notes: Abudi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Abudi is derived from the Arabic root 'Abd' meaning 'servant' or 'worshipper'. The suffix 'Udi' means 'father of'. This name signifies the father of a great or noble individual. The name Abudi carries the meaning “Father of a great one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abudi usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a great one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Abudi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of a great one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abudi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
